description: Phase 14: chart-trend recognition. Fixture is a 5-bar chart with monotonically decreasing values (200,160,120,80,40). Prompt asks whether the trend is increasing or decreasing; correct answer contains 'decreasing' (or 'decrease' / 'down' as accepted variants).

image_fixture.license: Luak-owned synthetic; no real PII; generated by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py (phase14 v1)
image_fixture.notes: 5-bar chart with values 200/160/120/80/40 left-to-right. Clear monotonic decrease.

questions.question: Look at the bar chart. Is the trend increasing or decreasing across the five days? Reply with one or two words.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for monotonic trend recognition. PASS = response contains any decreasing-direction indicator within 80 chars.

known_scoring_limitations: Text-match accepts 'decreasing' / 'decreas' / 'going down' / 'trend down' / 'downward'. A model that answers 'falling' would FAIL — accept that as a cost of staying deterministic.
